description:
The brutal fate is colored by the warm moonlight and becomes love.

Yuri, the Fifth Princess, stopped growing at the age of 12 after her mother, a lowly dancer, died. But her days of living in hiding in a remote corner of the palace came to a swift end when she was chosen by the Emperor as the fourth bride of the Black King, the ruler of the northwestern part of the empire and a man who made a name for himself on the battlefield from the age of 14.

The same Black King whose previous three imperial brides all met untimely deaths, earning him the nickname of the Bride-Eating War Demon. 

Will this marriage turn out to be an opportunity for Princess Yuri or will it end up being just another misfortune?
